title: “It’s trained by non-disabled people”: Evaluating How Image Quality Affects Product Captioning with VLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the product identification accuracy of four Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a dataset of naturalistic images taken by blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, specifically measuring performance drops caused by common real-world image quality issues (blur, misframing, and rotation) compared to high-quality baseline images.
